releaseNotes:
Fixes

Bank capture no longer treats Gmail or other apps as payments
Refresh can reconnect notification access after the phone sleeps
Needs review no longer shows a count when the list is empty
Delete local data clears sample salary and grocery amounts

Improvements

Splash checks for updates and can open the Play Store
Splash asks for notification access so bank alerts can be captured
Payment alerts say Payment detected and use the F.F.S icon
